technique_name: Write a story about two friends trying to achieve a difficult task together
description: Jack and Linda were childhood friends that had gone their separate ways after college, but when Linda learned that Jack had taken on a difficult task she wanted to help him in any way she could. She called him out of the blue one day, offering her help. Jack was skeptical at first, but after a long conversation, he agreed to let her join him.
